title: Beyond Naturalness: Probing Automated Text-To-Speech Evaluators on Linguistically Grounded Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2608.09930v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automated Text-to-Speech (TTS) evaluation methods (Mean Opinion Score (MOS) predictors and Audio Large Language Model (Audio-LLM) judges) are expected to reflect human perception, yet it is unclear how well they capture the distinct aspects of speech that listeners actually perceive. We deconstruct "naturalness" into a linguistically grounded annotation schema spanning 10 distinct perceptual dimensions, and use it to construct the first dimension-level meta-evaluation benchmark for TTS, comprising 860 utterances annotated by trained linguist raters. Results from benchmarking four MOS predictors and four Audio-LLM judges reveal that MOS predictors are more sensitive to acoustic signal-level properties at the prosodic and paralinguistic levels, while Audio-LLM judges show selective, prompt-dependent detection that favors word-level errors and does not generalize across all dimensions. translated_title: 超越自然度：在语言学奠基的维度上探测自动文本转语音评估器
translated_abstract: 自动文本转语音（TTS）评估方法（平均意见得分（MOS）预测器和音频大语言模型（Audio-LLM）评判者）被期望能够反映人类的感知，但它们在多大程度上能捕捉到听者实际感知到的语音的不同方面尚不清楚。我们将“自然度”解构为一个涵盖10个不同感知维度的、以语言学为基础的标注体系，并利用该体系构建了首个面向TTS的维度级元评估基准，包含由受过训练的语言学评分员标注的860条语音。对四个MOS预测器和四个Audio-LLM评判者的基准测试结果表明：MOS预测器对韵律和副语言层面的声学信号级属性更为敏感，而Audio-LLM评判者则表现出选择性的、依赖提示词的检测能力，更倾向于捕捉词级错误，且无法在所有维度上泛化。两类评估方法都无法可靠地捕捉……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将TTS评估中的“自然度”解构为10个语言学感知维度，构建了首个维度级元评估基准（860条由语言学家标注的语音），并揭示MOS预测器和Audio-LLM评判者各自仅能捕捉人类语音感知的部分维度，无法全面覆盖。
en_tdlr: The paper deconstructs TTS "naturalness" into 10 linguistically grounded perceptual dimensions to build the first dimension-level meta-evaluation benchmark (860 linguist-annotated utterances), revealing that MOS predictors and Audio-LLM judges each capture only partial aspects of human speech perception.
